meta.proxy: process-pool proxy; not taskqueue job execution timing

notes: Synthetic repos (fixed seed): results measure the heuristic indexer/search on generated TS, not a real codebase.
large-file-scan is a read + line-split + token-count proxy, NOT a Monaco render measurement.
Win/mac runs are placeholders in this landing: the suite is plain node and can run there, but Electron first-paint and signed-packaging checks need real Win/mac machines and are not covered here.
Product DB journal_mode (via copy, read-only): wal. WAL is NOT enabled by this suite; enabling it is a separate decision (see README).
